form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.notes: Born-digital fillable form, typed figures. Amounts are printed with a single decimal place ('2623.5') exactly as shown - not normalized to 2623.50. The Office field reads simply 'Auditor' (index.csv says 'County Auditor' - a naming-convention difference, not a conflict). No political-party field on this form. Street address, city/state/zip and signature are redacted upstream by the county (black bars), so residence_city is ''. This v. 4.20 form carries a 'Seven days preceding Convention' option that the later v. 12.23 form does not; that option is the one marked. The cover page header names Clerk/Auditor Josh Daniels while the summary page header names Amelia Powers Gardner - the county reissued the form mid-cycle; both are the form's own printed letterhead.

notes: The chunk listed pages 7 and 9 as summary pages, but page 9 is the county's internal 'CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST' (two staff review sign-offs dated 4/4/22), not a second report. ONE report only; page 7 is the sole Summary Page.
